company.name: Osmind
company.shortDescription: Osmind is the premier technology platform for breakthough mental health treatment and research.
company.description: Osmind is a San Francisco–based public benefit corporation led by scientists, technologists, and psychiatrists to advance new evidence-based medicine that helps people living with moderate to severe mental health conditions. For more information, please visit osmind.org.

productsAndServices.description: An integrated platform combining psychiatry-specific electronic health records (EHR), billing, and prior authorization services tailored for treatments like Spravato and TMS.
productsAndServices.name: Osmind 360

productsAndServices.description: A psychiatry-focused electronic health record system with ketamine-specific charting and integrated patient app for mood tracking and validated questionnaires.
productsAndServices.name: Psychiatry Electronic Health Record (EHR)

productsAndServices.description: Billing and revenue cycle management services specialized for psychiatry, including prior authorizations for Spravato and TMS, credentialing, and denial management.
productsAndServices.name: Psychiatry Billing Services

productsAndServices.description: A professional community platform for psychiatric clinicians and researchers to share best practices, treatment updates, and collaborate on mental health advancements.
productsAndServices.name: Psychiatry Collective

productsAndServices.description: A patient-facing mobile application enabling mood tracking, HIPAA-compliant messaging, and electronic submission of superbills.
productsAndServices.name: Patient App for Mood Tracking and Communication

aiResearchSummary.text: Osmind is engaged in developing a system for medical treatment recommendation and predictive modeling, as described in the title 'System for medical treatment recommendation and predictive model thereof.' The abstract details a method for adherence prediction using training and test datasets, model training across multiple trials, and validation folds. These efforts focus on leveraging data-driven approaches to support mental health treatment and research.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $40,000,000, or 69.96% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,864,891 to $287,336,270, a 74.35x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
